prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Phoenix to fix my air conditioning?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” HVAC company in Phoenix from these results, but **Parker & Sons**, **Goettl**, **Howard Air**, and **Precision Air** all stand out as strong candidates for AC repair based on their size, availability, and reputations.[1][2][14][17]

If you want the safest *one-company* pick from the results, **Parker & Sons** is the strongest all-around choice here because it advertises 24/7 availability, HVAC repair/maintenance, and an A+ BBB rating, plus a long-running “Voted #1” claim.[1] **Goettl** is also a strong option if you want another established Phoenix provider with 24/7 service and repeated local “Best HVAC Company” recognition.[14][20]

A practical shortlist would be:

- **Parker & Sons** — 24/7 service, BBB A+, broad HVAC/plumbing coverage.[1]
- **Goettl** — 24/7 service, same-day repairs, long Phoenix presence.[14][20]
- **Howard Air** — Phoenix-focused HVAC and plumbing company marketed as “Premier.”[2]
- **Precision Air** — immediate assistance line and dedicated HVAC/plumbing service.[17]

If you want the best repair outcome, I’d also recommend getting **at least three written quotes** and comparing warranty terms, response time, and whether permit costs are included.[10]
